strategy.offer: Prescription medicines, OTC remedies, supplements, self-care products, and contract manufacturing, packaging, development and technology transfer services.
strategy.customers: Patients and pharmacy shoppers, healthcare professionals and pharmacies, and other healthcare companies needing outsourced development, manufacturing, and packaging.
strategy.why_we_win: It emphasizes practical customer benefits, easier use, modern compliant production, flexible service, and patented or improved formulations that support competitiveness and adherence.
strategy.resources: Modern manufacturing and packaging capacity, serialization systems, formulation and transfer know-how, patent-protected products, export approvals, and longstanding contract-manufacturing experience.
strategy.direction: Expand outsourced manufacturing, grow internationally, develop improved release forms, and build differentiated pharmacy-exclusive health products to reduce dependence on reimbursement contracts.
